action.description: Which operation to perform: 'create' a new schedule, 'list' this tool's schedules (always scoped to the configured graph_id), 'update' an existing schedule (requires schedule_id), or 'delete' an existing schedule (requires schedule_id).

schedule_id.description: ID of an existing schedule. Required for 'update' and 'delete'. Ignored for 'create'/'list'.

node_name.description: Human-readable name for the schedule. Optional for 'create' — an auto-generated unique name is used if omitted. Optional for 'update' to rename.

run_mode.description: 'once' fires a single time at start_date_time. 'repeat' fires every N units (see 'every'/'unit') starting at start_date_time. Required for 'create'.

start_date_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. '2026-07-06T09:00:00'). Naive values are interpreted in 'timezone'. Required for 'create' when run_mode is set.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used to interpret naive start_date_time/end_date_time values, e.g. 'UTC', 'Europe/Kyiv'. Optional, default 'UTC'.

every.description: Interval size for run_mode='repeat', e.g. 2 with unit='hours' means every 2 hours. Required for run_mode='repeat'.

unit.description: Interval unit for run_mode='repeat'. Required for run_mode='repeat'.

weekdays.description: Optional list of weekday codes (mon/tue/wed/thu/fri/sat/sun) restricting repeat fires. Only valid with unit='days' or unit='weeks'.

end_type.description: When the schedule stops firing. 'never' runs indefinitely, 'on_date' stops after end_date_time, 'after_n_runs' stops after max_runs fires. Optional, default 'never'.

end_date_time.description: ISO 8601 datetime after which the schedule stops firing. Required when end_type='on_date'.

max_runs.description: Maximum number of times the schedule may fire before auto-deactivating. Required when end_type='after_n_runs'.

is_active.description: Whether the schedule should be enabled. Optional, default true for 'create'.

apply_jitter.description: If true (default), a small random offset (0-jitter_seconds_max seconds) is added to a start_date_time that lands exactly on a round boundary (:00 or :30 seconds=0), so recurring schedules don't all fire in the same instant as everyone else's. Set false to use start_date_time exactly as given.

jitter_seconds_max.description: Upper bound (exclusive) in seconds for the random jitter offset described in apply_jitter. Optional, default 45.

graph_id.description: ID of the saved flow (graph) this tool manages schedules for. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent can never create/list/update/delete a schedule for any other graph.

api_key.description: EpicStaff API key used to authenticate the schedule-trigger-nodes calls (sent as the X-Api-Key header). Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the EpicStaff Django REST API, e.g. http://djangoapp:8000/api. Optional — if unset, falls back to the DJANGO_API_URL environment variable, then to http://djangoapp:8000/api.
